elements.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The added clause applies expressly “[o]n expiry or termination of this Agreement or any Order Form.”

elements.element: Vendor provides transition assistance for up to six months.
elements.evidence: Vendor is required to provide at least ninety days of assistance, not assistance for a period of up to six months.

elements.element: Transition assistance is charged at then-current rates.
elements.evidence: The rendered language does not state any rates or charges for transition assistance.

elements.element: Vendor returns Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Vendor must export all Customer Data to Customer within thirty days following the stated expiry-or-termination trigger.

elements.element: Customer Data is returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: No standard, machine-readable, or other export format is specified.

elements.element: Vendor certifies deletion of Customer Data after its return.
elements.evidence: No deletion certification is required. Section 16.5 does not supply one and expressly defers governance of Customer Data elsewhere.
